title: We have been getting broken ones over and over each time we order. Always 1 broken one.
text: We have been getting broken ones over and over each time we order. Always 1 broken one.. We have been ordering these for a while for our water pitcher and last two batches we got we always get one that's completely smashed down or broken :s you can hear the sand inside the package moving around and it's a lot of it so it's weird. We kind of need these to be able to use our water filter but we are already considering gettting a different water filtering pitcher because of this issue. The filters normally work well but we have had instances where even after following all the instructions there are still small bits of black sand coming out in the water we are drinking so I am unsure about giving this more than 3 stars, and would give it 2 if it wasn't because I haven't really ad any problem with the filters other than that time and the fact they always send us at least one that's broken. Which, I think is very unprofessional to add one that doesn't work in the batch you give customers :s
